title: the Glass Steppe Rising Revisited
author: J. M. Reyes
blurb: Felix Brightwater, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
